newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Uniban bank to hold meeting before merger.
newsitem.headline: Uniban bank to hold meeting before merger.

text.p: Spain's Uniban bank on Wednesday said it will hold a shareholders meeting on Thursday to confirm the merger with Morocco's Wafabank.
The meeting, initially expected for December 30, 1996, had been delayed for "technical reasons", a Uniban spokesman.
"Thursday's meeting will examine, among other issues, the final decision of merging with Wafabank," he said.
Wafabank decided to buy 100 percent of Uniban or more than 2.46 million shares priced at around $28 million, a bourse official said.
A Casablanca-based stockbroker said: "The delay was apparently due to differences between management and shareholders over the shares parity."
Wafabank is offering one share in exchange for five shares of Uniban while shareholders wanted one share against four, the broker added.
Uniban registered a net profit of 0.6 million dirhams in the first half of this year from losses of 27.2 million dirhams in the whole period of 1995.
No updated figures have yet been released by either institutions.
The effective absorption of Uniban by Wafabank will take place by end March 1997, a Wafabank official said.
Wafabank aims to diversify its financial sources and take a larger stake on the market, including opening a branch in Madrid. It also wants to reduce costs, he added.

With a market capitalisation of more than 3.0 billion dirhams and one of the market's most liquid stocks, Wafabank made a net profit of 83 million dirhams in the first half of the year from 78.4 million in the same period in 1995.
Wafabank's turnover reached 801.5 million dirhams for the period of January-June 1996 from 711 million dirhams in the same period in 1995.
Fuelled by the rumours of the merger, Wafabank shares have been rising recently. They were traded at 580 dirhams on Wednesday, up nine dirhams from the previous session.
Established in Casablanca since 1911, Wafabank is among the 47 stocks listed on the Casablanca stock exchange.
